notes.title: Tiny Teams! Demo update
notes.notes:
[h1]Tiny Teams is here![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892249/40b156a8866fdfc78eaed9ce7caff257ccf660a0.png[/img]

I'm so grateful to be part of this year's Tiny Teams celebration! This festival showcases beautiful, interesting, and unique games created by solo devs and small groups. Its a great opportunity to discover a handful of games you've never heard of. Please check out all these great games here - [url= https://yogsca.st/TT24]Tiny Teams on Steam[/url] 

Pinball Blitz has gotten quite the face lift in anticipation for this festival.. 
[list]
[*] The Pinball Wizard is now expecting you after each level-up, excited to grant you a potion to help you succeed.
[*] The first boss makes its appearance on level 6..
[*] A run now ends with a final blitz - a stand against the table as enemies speed up and points fly.
[*] A new theme: "POTION"
[/list]

As always, if you ever run into an issue or have a bright, new suggestion, don't hesitate to reach out! I would love to hear your input - [url=https://discord.gg/jRqtdjKUHf]Discord[/url]
